_comment: FCS confocal calculator, drawn by emtk.view_form over ConfocalModel (gui/model.py). The fields and descriptions of fcs_calculator.view.json (the Qt tool's spec); its custom constraint, dye and shape sections are spec sections here (radio choices, a dye choice, value fields, buttons). Computed fields are read-only through ConfocalModel.enabled. The custom section confocal_json (Export / Import JSON with file dialogs) is drawn by gui/app.py.

sections.title: Constraint (choose one)
sections.description: Which of D, rₕ and Veff you know; the other two are computed from it.
Fix D, rₕ or Veff: that field is the input, the other two are computed and read-only.

sections.title: Diffusion / volume
sections.description: Correlation time, diffusion, size, focus shape, temperature and viscosity.

sections.label: τ (µs)
sections.description: Diffusion correlation time τ_D.

sections.label: D (µm²/s)
sections.description: Translational diffusion coefficient (read-only unless 'Fix D').

sections.label: rₕ (nm)
sections.description: Hydrodynamic radius (read-only unless 'Fix rₕ').

sections.label: S (wz/wxy)
sections.description: Confocal aspect ratio (axial / lateral beam waist).

sections.label: Veff (fL)
sections.description: Effective confocal volume (read-only unless 'Fix Veff').

sections.label: T (°C)
sections.description: Temperature.

sections.label: η (mPa·s)
sections.description: Solvent viscosity; computed from the water model when 'Use water η(T)' is enabled.

sections.label: Use water η(T)
sections.description: Use the temperature-dependent viscosity of water (Kapusta 2010 app note).

sections.title: Occupancy
sections.description: Occupancy and concentration, linked through Veff.

sections.label: 1/N
sections.description: Inverse occupancy G(0) = 1/N; exceeds 1 for sub-single-molecule occupancy.

sections.label: N
sections.description: Average number of molecules in Veff.

sections.label: Conc (nM)
sections.description: Concentration; N = 0.602214 × c_nM × Veff_fL.

sections.title: Reference dye (D @ 25 °C, water)
sections.description: Set D from a reference species with a known diffusion coefficient.
The reference species and the button that applies it.
Reference species from MMFDB carrying a diffusion coefficient D(25 °C, water); curate them in the MMFDB admin tool.
Apply the reference.

buttons.label: Apply Dref
buttons.description: Set D from the selected reference (scaled as chosen below) and switch to Fix D.

sections.description: Scale the reference D from 25 °C water to the current temperature and viscosity (Stokes-Einstein), or use it as tabulated.

sections.title: Molecular shape
sections.description: Estimate D from an assumed shape and size.

sections.label: Type
sections.description: Sphere (Stokes-Einstein), prolate ellipsoid (Perrin friction factor) or cylinder (Hansen approximation).

sections.label: Size (nm)
sections.description: Sphere diameter, ellipsoid minor-axis diameter or cylinder diameter, in nanometres.

sections.label: Aspect
sections.description: Ellipsoid major/minor axis ratio or cylinder length/diameter (not used for a sphere).
Apply the shape estimate.

buttons.label: Apply shape→D
buttons.description: Compute D for this shape at the current temperature and viscosity and switch to Fix D.

sections.title: Settings JSON
sections.description: Save or load every value, the constraint, the reference and the shape.
Export or import the calculator's settings as JSON.
